newsitem.title: USA: Killer wiped JonBenet's body with cloth - Colo. paper.
newsitem.headline: Killer wiped JonBenet's body with cloth - Colo. paper.

text.p: Police on Tuesday declined to comment on a published report the killer of 6-year-old beauty pageant winner JonBenet Ramsey used a cloth to wipe her body that left fibers on her skin.
"We are not responding to that (report)," Leslie Aaholm, spokeswoman for the city, said.
The Rocky Mountain News reported that experts believe such an effort could explain why a small amount of bodily fluid was recovered from the child's body.
The newspaper said its sources would not disclose if the cloth has been found.
JonBenet's body was found Dec. 26 in a windowless basement in the family's home in Boulder, some eight hours after her mother said she found a ransom note demanding $118,000.
The little girl was strangled and according to published reports was also sexually assaulted.
The police have been tight-lipped about the progress of the investigation into the murder, which has captured national headlines.
"The case is still the highest priority of the police department," Aaholm said, adding that 10 to 15 personnel were still assigned to the case.
